name: Machine Learning for Digital Signal Processing
description:
Review of digital signal processing fundamentals and signal representations
Data acquisition, preprocessing, feature extraction, and labeling for signals
Classical DSP vs ML-based signal processing: motivations and trade-offs
Supervised learning methods for signal classification and regression
Unsupervised and adaptive learning techniques for signal modeling
Neural networks for DSP: CNNs, RNNs, and transformers for time-series signals
ML-based filtering, denoising, and noise cancellation techniques
Real-time and streaming signal processing using ML models
Model optimization for deployment: quantization, pruning, and latency constraints
Case studies and hands-on projects in audio, biomedical, radar, or communication signals
